paper.title_en: Optical and Dynamical Signatures of Padé Approximated Wormholes in $f(T)$ Gravity
paper.abstract_en: We construct traversable wormhole solutions in the linear teleparallel model $f(T) = αT + β$, adopting Padé approximants of order [1/0] and [0/1] as shape functions together with the redshift function $Φ(r) = -M/r$, and derive the corresponding source terms from the modified field equations. We assess the physical viability of both configurations through the energy conditions, Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff equilibrium, the volume integral quantifier, thin-shell junction matching to an exterior Schwarzschild vacuum, embedding diagrams, proper radial distance, the gravitational energy and the active mass. We then examine the observational signatures of each geometry by analysing equatorial null geodesics and the photon-sphere structure, computing shadow maps and radial intensity profiles, ray-tracing relativistic images of a geometrically thin accretion disc, and integrating timelike rosette orbits. Finally, we study the dynamical stability of both wormholes through a third-order WKB quasinormal-mode analysis across scalar, electromagnetic, and axial gravitational perturbations, cross-checked against time-domain evolution and the eikonal photon-sphere correspondence, and examine the parameter dependence of the mode spectrum together with the possibility of trapped-mode echoes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在 f(T) 引力框架下构建可穿越虫洞解，系统性检验能量条件、TOV 平衡、体积积分量化子、薄壳匹配等物理可行性，并深入分析赤道零测地线、光子球、阴影、吸积盘成像及类时玫瑰花结轨道等光学/动力学特征，同时用三阶 WKB 及时间域演化研究准正规模稳定性，理论深度与方法论信号较强；虽属新近预印本且引用为零（按规则中性），仍值得点击细读。
decision.title_zh: f(T) 引力中 Padé 近似虫洞的光学与动力学特征
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在线性远平行引力模型 $f(T) = \alpha T + \beta$ 中构造可穿越虫洞解，采用 [1/0] 和 [0/1] 阶 Padé 近似作为形状函数，结合红移函数 $\Phi(r) = -M/r$，并由修改场方程导出相应的源项。我们通过能量条件、Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff 平衡、体积积分量化子、与外部 Schwarzschild 真空的薄壳连接匹配、嵌入图、固有径向距离、引力能量和活动质量，评估两种构型的物理可行性。随后，我们通过分析赤道零测地线和光子球结构、计算阴影图和径向强度分布、对几何薄吸积盘的相对论像进行光线追踪，以及对类时玫瑰花结轨道进行积分，来研究每种几何的观测特征。最后，我们通过对标量、电磁和轴向引力扰动进行三阶 WKB 准正规模分析，并与时间域演化和 eikonal 光子球对应进行交叉检验，研究两个虫洞的动力学稳定性，同时考察模式谱的参数依赖性以及捕获模式回声的可能性。
